data.name: Marziyah
data.gender_notes: Marziyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Marziyah is an Arabic origin name that means 'wished for' or 'desired'. It is a name that reflects the joy and happiness of having a child. The name Marziyah carries the meaning “Wished for” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Marziyah usually hope their child will grow to embody wished for and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Marziyah is considered a blessed name as it reflects the idea of a child being a gift from Allah.
data.etymology: Marziyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wished for.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Marziyah total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic society, the birth of a child is considered to be a blessing, and the naming ceremony is an essential part of introducing the newborn to the family and community. The name Marziyah signifies the parents' deepest wishes and desires for their child, as well as their hope for a bright and prosperous future. This name is also associated with the Prophet Muhammad's saying, "I and the one who calls me, shall be in love, until the day we meet (in paradise)." This hadith highlights the importance of love and desire in the relationship between parents and their children.

In Islamic tradition, every name has a spiritual dimension, and Marziyah is no exception. The name symbolizes the parent's hope for their child to be a person of virtue, one who is desired by God and strives to achieve His pleasure. It also reminds us of the hadith, "The closest that man can come to God is through his child," emphasizing the special connection between parents and their children as a reflection of the relationship between God and His creation. Additionally, Marziyah can be seen as a reminder of the human desire for God's love and mercy, as stated in the Quran, "And We have already sent a Messenger (Muhammad) to every community [saying]: 'Worship Allah and avoid [and deter] evil.' " (Quran 16:36) Thus, the name Marziyah encourages us to strive towards God and to cultivate the qualities that He desires in us.
